motion.evidence: 6 @keyframes (spin, vanishTwinkleA/B/C, delay-overflow, osano-load-scale); 5 IntersectionObservers / 4 targets (thresholds 1 & 0.5, rootMargins 150% 0% & 200px); ~2449 rAF/scroll pass (GSAP ScrollTrigger ticker); 107 scroll + 23 mousemove listeners; 1 prefers-reduced-motion block (respected). Real content effects only: background-shift rgb(247,248,250)→rgb(205,210,248) on 'It's all here'; SVG <g> scale 1.08/1.12/1.426→1 + opacity 1.00→0.19 on bento mini-UIs; sticky pull-quote (p.); path-draw box ('animate each path in its own box'). Dropped 8 raw pins that were cookie-banner/nav fixed-position noise and all from==to representation noise. Library-driven (GSAP+ScrollTrigger+Webflow IX2), unlike Attio's hand-rolled CSS.

notes: Normalized from a noisy raw profile (2492 of ~2900 nodes were 16px body; sub-pixel sizes 22.4/21.6/28.6px and the dozen one-off heading sizes rounded to a coherent 8-step ramp). Two real families: Inter Variable for all UI/body, and the Reckless serif (raw 'Reckless, Georgia') reserved for display headlines and the pull-quote — confirmed by screenshot (every large headline is serif; everything else sans). Weights collapsed to 400/500/600 (raw 700 count=5 is noise). DUAL-CANVAS palette is the defining trait and the screenshot is ground truth here: light sections are white/#f7f8fa surfaces with #181822 ink and #6d6e87 muted; the brand 'rest' canvas is lavender #ddd6ff (hero) / #cdd2f8 + deep #260048 (footer); narrative sections invert to a near-black #21222f. Accent unified to violet #5e05c4 (the button/CTA fill, sampled exact); raw also shows a lighter #8f47d5 (icon/link tint) and pastel #ba9dff (kept as accent-soft). Green is the only semantic, used in the product-mock progress UI: text #0b885b on fill #a4f4cf / tint #d1f9e7. Amber #f9c71c appears once (the announcement-bar sparkle) — kept as a one-off highlight, not a UI color. Radii collapsed to 8px (cards), 16px (large panels), 9999px (pills/buttons); the 100%/50% entries are avatars/icons. Only two real shadows: a hairline card lift and one diffuse 30px glow on floating mock UI — most surfaces are flat, separated by the canvas color change, not shadow. Spacing on an 8px base; section rhythm jumps 32→64→80→128px. Transitions are overwhelmingly the house 0.2s ease (count 245); a few bespoke cubic-beziers used for scroll/hover.
